altText: Fan photo from the Eras Tour, shared on r/TaylorSwiftPictures: Beautiful Showgirl

critique.rationale: Taylor gushing over another artist on Fallon ('tit for tat,' 'full volume, over and over again') plus her named streaming rotation — a warm, sourced, of-the-moment fan moment refreshed by Tate's own Fallon reaction today. X takes the quote-led angle vs IG's fuller story. Fan photo is a generic Eras tile, loosely tied.

why: Event draft for intake #5902 (Tate McRae on The Tonight Show, 'Talks Taylor Swift Shock', YouTube Jsb-nfZ2TbQ, oEmbed-verified). The real Taylor fact: on Fallon (Oct 6) she raved about Tate McRae's 'Tit For Tat' — verbatim quote confirmed by Billboard — and named Tate, Sabrina Carpenter & sombr as who she constantly streams (SiriusXM, via Billboard); Tate reacted with shock, refreshed by today's Fallon video. Photo is the run's reserved eventPhoto (uncredited u/unknown, so no credit line); X uses the full-res xOriginal of the same image as the IG half (one pair, one photo).
